findings.title: The step is launch bound
findings.evidence: the device is busy 7% of the step (689 of 9919 ms) over 38101 launches and 723402 operators per step, 258 us of host time per launch
findings.lever: graph replay (trainer.graph=true) removes the launch cost if the capture can use the same kernels

findings.title: Much of the module time has no cost model
findings.evidence: 3049 of 11256 ms is in modules the cost model does not know

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: conv output_blocks.in_layers (up)
findings.evidence: 457.3 ms per step against an ideal 13.8 ms (3% efficient, compute-bound), 9 layers; all rated pieces together leave 8026 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: conv output_blocks.skip_connection (up)
findings.evidence: 306.8 ms per step against an ideal 1.6 ms (1% efficient, compute-bound), 9 layers; all rated pieces together leave 8026 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: linear ff.net (up)
findings.evidence: 262.6 ms per step against an ideal 6.1 ms (2% efficient, compute-bound), 36 layers; all rated pieces together leave 8026 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: linear attn2.to_k (up)
findings.evidence: 247.3 ms per step against an ideal 1.0 ms (0% efficient, memory-bound), 36 layers; all rated pieces together leave 8026 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Slowest pieces by recoverable time: linear attn2.to_v (up)
findings.evidence: 246.4 ms per step against an ideal 1.0 ms (0% efficient, memory-bound), 36 layers; all rated pieces together leave 8026 ms
findings.lever: see the module table for the individual layers

findings.title: Dtype and copy kernels take a large share
findings.evidence: 22% of device time is casts and copies
findings.lever: find the modules issuing `.to(dtype)` round trips (autocast boundaries, adapter branches) and keep one dtype through them

findings.title: Many small memory-bound kernels
findings.evidence: 42% of device time (24255 calls per step) is elementwise, normalisation, copy, memory and reduction work
findings.lever: fusion (fewer, larger kernels): norm + modulation, activation + multiply, cast + matmul input; half the time is the most a fusion usually recovers

findings.title: The int8 path's own kernels are a large share
findings.evidence: rotate, quantize and dequantize kernels are 15% of device time against 179 ms of matmuls
findings.lever: int8_grad=int8 (no weight dequantize in backward), or a fused rotate+quantize in the kernels project; native weights if memory allows

findings.title: Module times do not add up to the device time
findings.evidence: modules account for 11256 ms of 689 ms device time per eager step
findings.lever: the difference is work outside the hooked modules (loss, optimizer, data movement) or host waits; see the phase and category tables
